scope: A generic square-root small-ball / half-Riesz certificate for an arbitrary residual law, even with an L1 cap L2 residual density, cannot by itself be combined with one independent cap-one square to imply a bounded output density. This is an abstract interface obstruction, not a counterexample to QFORM product-provenance residuals.
summary: Construct g(r) proportional to [sqrt(-r) log(1/(-r))]^{-1} near 0- plus a bounded completion. Then g is a probability density in L1 intersect L2 and obeys sup_t P(|R-t|<rho)<=H sqrt(rho). For independent V with triangular cap-one C0 density, p_{R+V^2}(-tau) grows like log log(1/tau), hence is unbounded. Any current half-Riesz-plus-third-square splice needs an exponent gain, an Lp residual with p>2, or richer retained product/cancellation structure.
